scripts.title: Auto fishing open source
scripts.script:
--@info: this script was maded using ChatGPT 6.7
local Fishing = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Controllers.FishingController)

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.05) -- or just task.wait()

        if Fishing:GetCurrentGUID() then
            Fishing:FishingMinigameClick()
        elseif not Fishing:OnCooldown() then
            Fishing:RequestChargeFishingRod(
                Vector2.new(
                    workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X / 2,
                    workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y / 2
                ),
                true
            )
        end
    end
end)
